handoff.plan:
scene_representation:
  planning_mode: explicit
  decision_summary: Live camera feed stays full-screen as the backdrop (composition none). Gameplay is
    a screen-space 2D layer at 720x1280 with falling hat items and edge HUD. A Head Tracker rig
    supplies a forehead anchor whose world position is projected to screen pixels each frame, so the
    catcher collider follows the user's real forehead without moving the camera feed.
  space:
    kind: screen
    description: 720x1280 screen space for all gameplay items and HUD, layered directly over the camera feed.
  content_form:
    kind: flat_2d
    description: Flat 2D sprites, art text and a soft radial forehead ring, plus 3D camera and head
      tracker rig underneath.
  requirements:
    - id: capture.head_follows_forehead
      description: The catcher hit point tracks the user's real forehead position every frame and mirrors
        head movement horizontally and vertically.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.head_rig
        - layer.gameplay_2d
      verification_refs:
        - verify.head_tracking
    - id: capture.feed_always_visible
      description: The live camera feed stays visible and unobstructed in the center of the screen during
        calibration, gameplay and result.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.camera_feed
      verification_refs:
        - verify.feed_visibility
    - id: feedback.immediate_hit_readout
      description: Every caught or missed item produces immediate visible feedback (pop burst, score
        number, red flash and shake) and a matching sound.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.gameplay_2d
        - layer.hud
      verification_refs:
        - verify.hit_feedback
    - id: hud.safe_zone_layout
      description: All HUD text and the retry button stay inside the TikTok safe zone so nothing is
        clipped by the TikTok UI.
      must: false
      layer_refs:
        - layer.hud
      verification_refs:
        - verify.safe_zone
  layers:
    - id: layer.head_rig
      role: head tracking rig
      description: Main Camera plus Head Tracker; an Empty child at forehead height supplies the
        world-space anchor that is projected to screen pixels.
      space:
        kind: world
        description: 3D camera space driven by head tracking
      content_form:
        kind: volumetric_3d
        description: Tracking anchor transform only, no visible mesh
      requirement_refs:
        - capture.head_follows_forehead
    - id: layer.gameplay_2d
      role: falling items and catcher ring
      description: 2D Camera canvas holding the forehead ring, pooled falling hat items, gold gifts and
        bad bombs that spawn at the top and fall to the bottom.
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: Screen-space 2D canvas
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: Flat sprite quads positioned by script
      requirement_refs:
        - capture.head_follows_forehead
        - feedback.immediate_hit_readout
    - id: layer.hud
      role: HUD, screens and result card
      description: Score, miss icons, timer bar, countdown art text, calibration prompt and the
        translucent result card with retry button, all anchored to safe-zone edges.
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: Screen-space 2D canvas
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: Flat art text, labels and translucent panels
      requirement_refs:
        - hud.safe_zone_layout
        - feedback.immediate_hit_readout
    - id: layer.camera_feed
      role: live camera background
      description: Full-screen camera feed rendered behind every 2D layer, never covered by an opaque panel.
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: Full-screen camera feed background
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: Live video texture
      requirement_refs:
        - capture.feed_always_visible
  limitations:
    - Hit detection uses distance in projected screen pixels, not true 3D depth, so an item is
      caught when its 2D distance to the projected forehead point is small.
    - Without a detected face the forehead anchor falls back to screen center so the game stays
      playable in the editor preview.
  verification:
    - id: verify.head_tracking
      description: Move the preview head horizontally and vertically, then compare the ring position with
        the head tracker.
      requirement_refs:
        - capture.head_follows_forehead
      views_or_states:
        - head centered
        - head turned left
        - head moved up
      success_criteria: The ring follows the forehead in the same direction with no visible lag or drift.
    - id: verify.feed_visibility
      description: Screenshot calibration, gameplay and result screens and confirm the face region is
        unobstructed.
      requirement_refs:
        - capture.feed_always_visible
      views_or_states:
        - calibration screen
        - active gameplay
        - result screen
      success_criteria: The center of the frame shows the live camera feed at all times with no opaque
        full-screen panel.
    - id: verify.hit_feedback
      description: Trigger a normal catch, a gold catch and a bad catch and inspect the pop text, burst,
        red flash and shake.
      requirement_refs:
        - feedback.immediate_hit_readout
      views_or_states:
        - normal catch
        - gold catch
        - bad catch
        - miss
      success_criteria: Score popup and burst appear within one frame of contact and a miss flashes red
        with a screen shake.
    - id: verify.safe_zone
      description: Inspect the layout bounds of every HUD element and the retry button against the safe zone.
      requirement_refs:
        - hud.safe_zone_layout
      views_or_states:
        - gameplay HUD
        - result card with retry button
      success_criteria: All HUD items sit within x -340..260 and y -400..500.
  fallbacks:
    unknown_requirement: adapt_and_verify
    unmet_must: stop_and_explain
game_type:
  camera_feed: visible
  ar_tracking: head
  core_loop_seconds: 2
  total_duration_seconds: 45
starter_template:
  mode: none
  rationale: The closest strong buildable, chef_hat_catch, steers a pot by dragging and ends on a
    timer only. This design is head-tracked with a forehead collider, weighted item mix,
    consecutive-miss and cumulative-miss loss, and a speed ramp, so the scaffold's drag input would
    have to be ripped out. Built from scratch while borrowing its falling-item stream and HUD
    framing.

interactions:
  - kind: record_start_reset
    trigger: RecordStart event
    response: Reset score to 0, misses to 0, consecutive misses to 0, timer to 45, speed to base, clear
      all falling items, show CalibrationScreen and hide GameplayScreen and ResultScreen.
    state_change: ANY -> CALIBRATION
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: Forehead anchor held within 90 px of the red calibration line for 0.6 s
    response: Play the countdown 3-2-1-GO on the gameplay screen, then begin spawning falling hats.
    state_change: CALIBRATION -> COUNTDOWN -> PLAYING
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - el.calib_redline
    feedback:
      visual: Calibration line turns green and pulses, countdown art text pops in the center
      audio_asset_id: audio.countdown_tick
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: Falling item overlaps the projected forehead ring point
    response: Normal hat adds 1 point, gold gift adds 3 points and raises spawn speed, bad bomb
      subtracts 2 points and adds one miss; the item is recycled to the pool.
    state_change: null
    target:
      scope: asset
      asset_ids:
        - asset.cap_normal
        - asset.cap_gold
        - asset.bad_bomb
    feedback:
      visual: Item pops with a golden star burst, art-text score popup rises above the ring, HUD score
        bumps
      audio_asset_id: audio.catch_hat
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: A bad bomb touches the forehead ring and on every item that falls past the bottom edge uncaught
    response: Add one miss, shake the camera, flash the screen red and update the miss icons; reaching
      10 total misses or 5 consecutive misses ends the round immediately.
    state_change: PLAYING -> RESULT when the miss limit is hit
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - el.miss_flash
    feedback:
      visual: Red translucent screen flash plus a short camera shake and a shrinking miss icon
      audio_asset_id: audio.explode
  - kind: screen_transition
    trigger: 45 second timer expires
    response: Hide GameplayScreen, show ResultScreen with the final score, rank title, share copy and
      duet copy.
    state_change: PLAYING -> RESULT
    feedback:
      visual: Result card scales in with a soft glow while remaining camera feed stays visible
      audio_asset_id: audio.result
  - kind: retry
    trigger: Tap the RetryButton
    response: Reset score, misses, consecutive misses and timer, clear the item pool and return to the
      calibration screen.
    state_change: RESULT -> CALIBRATION
    feedback:
      visual: Retry button punch-scale and the result card slides out
      audio_asset_id: audio.countdown_tick

random_behaviors:
  - what: which item type spawns
    range: 65 percent normal cap, 15 percent golden gift, 20 percent bad bomb
    verify_strategy: Force spawn 20 items in preview and log the type counts, confirm the split is
      within 15 percent of the target weights.
  - what: spawn horizontal position
    range: uniform random x between -280 and 260 in screen space
    verify_strategy: Capture three gameplay screenshots and confirm every spawned item starts within the
      horizontal safe bounds.
  - what: fall speed after each five correct catches
    range: plus 10 percent of the base speed per five catches, capped at 1.8 times base
    verify_strategy: Log the speed multiplier after every fifth catch and confirm it ramps 1.0 to 1.1 to
      1.2 and stops at 1.8.
camera_feed_constraints:
  tracking_type: head
  tracking_range: full screen; the face stays visible in the center band while HUD elements hug the
    top and bottom safe-zone edges
  user_image_visible: true
  composition: none
mechanic:
  class: other
  description: "Head-tracked catching game: pooled hats, golden gifts and bad bombs fall from the top
    of the screen and the user catches the good ones with a forehead ring projected from the head
    tracker. Weighted item mix, speed ramp every five catches, and loss on ten total misses or five
    consecutive misses."
  parameters:
    base_fall_speed_px_per_sec: 300
    spawn_interval_sec: 0.85
    speed_multiplier_per_5_correct: 0.1
    max_speed_multiplier: 1.8
    score_normal: 1
    score_gold: 3
    score_bad: -2
    gold_speed_boost: 0.3
    catch_radius_px: 92
    max_misses: 10
    max_consecutive_misses: 5
    calibration_hold_sec: 0.6
    pool_size: 9
    hit_test: screen_distance_to_projected_forehead
criteria:
  - category: layout
    check: Score counter sits top-left, five miss icons top-right and the timer bar above them, all
      inside the safe zone.
  - category: layout
    check: No opaque full-screen panel covers the camera feed on any of the three screens; the result
      card is translucent.
  - category: state
    check: RecordStart resets score, misses, timer and item pool and returns to the calibration screen.
  - category: state
    check: Holding the head on the red line for 0.6 seconds starts the 3-2-1-GO countdown and then
      playing.
  - category: state
    check: Ten total misses or five consecutive misses ends the round immediately with the result screen.
  - category: state
    check: The retry button returns to calibration with a fully reset game state.
  - category: value
    check: Normal hat is plus one, golden gift is plus three with a thirty percent speed boost, bad bomb
      is minus two and counts one miss.
  - category: value
    check: Each five correct catches raises the global fall speed by ten percent up to one point eight
      times the base speed.
  - category: boundary
    check: The round always ends at forty five seconds even if no miss limit is reached.
  - category: boundary
    check: Score never drops below zero and the miss icon row never shows fewer than zero icons.
  - category: random
    check: Spawned item types follow the sixty five fifteen twenty weighting over a sample of twenty
      spawns.
  - category: camera_feed
    check: The camera feed stays visible and the foreground never hides the whole face region.
  - category: visual

template.rationale: The closest strong buildable, chef_hat_catch, steers a pot by dragging and ends on a timer only. This design is head-tracked with a forehead collider, weighted item mix, consecutive-miss and cumulative-miss loss, and a speed ramp, so the scaffold's drag input would have to be ripped out.
